subject: Cross-function goal reset playbook & dependency pitches
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@bridgepoint.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-function goal reset playbook & dependency pitches

Team —

Quick mid-cycle readout and a proposal for the next week: after reviewing OKR pacing across Serving Runtime and Product, I'm recommending a targeted, two-week goal reset to protect our Q3 revenue-led commitments while preserving longer-term platform bets. The intent is to reduce top-10 high-likelihood deliverable scope (not cancel) and explicitly surface dependency asks for the rest of the org and our partners.

TL;DR:
- We are behind on two Serving Runtime latency OKRs and one Optimize feature that materially impacts forecasted cost savings.
- Proposed action: compress scope for noncritical experiments, prioritize kernel/k8s patch for latency, and request 1x SRE rotation + 0.5 FTE from Infra for 3 weeks.
- External ask: Bridgepoint to confirm access window for on-prem benchmark next week (Jordan); Procurement to fast-track the MSA amendment for dedicated capacity (procurement@acme-analytics.com).

Details:
1) Status snapshot (attached Q3_runway_model.xlsx):
   - Serving Runtime: current 60% to target on 99th pct latency; risk of sliding SLA for one customer cohort.
   - Redwood Optimize: feature alpha delayed due to QA/infra flakiness — delays reduce projected unit-cost improvements by ~12% this quarter.
   - Product: two user-facing experiments can be deferred without blocking revenue launches.

2) Re-scope proposal (minimal disruption playbook):
   - Pause experimental quantization trials for 2 weeks (apply to non-dedicated builds).
   - Ship kernel patch (SERV-1024) as a high-priority hotfix — requires SRE pairing and CI runway.
   - Reassign a mid-level infra engineer (0.5 FTE) to the kernel/teamland for 3 weeks; temporary redeploy of one backend eng from Product to assist with integration tests for two weeks.

3) Dependency asks (who/what/when):
   - Infra: 1x SRE rotation (Vivek, can you confirm availability?) by Monday 8/10.
   - Partnerships/Bench: Jordan/Bridgepoint — need ephemeral access to on-prem rack for metric collection 8/11–8/13; please confirm windows.
   - Procurement: expedite amendment (DocuSign link in related_links) to allow dedicated-run tests in non-prod infra.

Next steps: if we agree, I'll draft a condensed playbook and communication for the QBR readout and notify customers with impacted SLAs (minimal, proactive). Please reply with confirmations / alternate suggestions by end-of-day Monday.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-function goal reset playbook & dependency pitches

Sofia — thanks for the clear framing and the workbook. I pulled the SERV-1024 runbook and talked to SRE leads; we have a on-call rotation gap the week of 8/10 but can swap schedules to cover the pairing if we get the request by Monday EOD.

Quick notes:
- I can commit to coordinating the 1x SRE rotation (we'll assign a named engineer after I sync with Mick).
- 0.5 FTE infra reallocation is possible for 3 weeks, but we should attach acceptance criteria to the reallocation (ability to run full perf regressions, two-week rollback plan).

Action: Sofia, please add the acceptance criteria to the playbook and tag me; I'll add a short runbook for the CI gating to ensure we don't introduce a regression during the hotfix.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability

Adding a couple product delivery constraints:

- We can defer the two non-revenue experiments, but Product needs a clear timeline to re-onboard the teams (suggested 6-week pause).
- If we shift the mid-level infra engineer 0.5 FTE, Product will need 1 week of overlap for knowledge transfer; propose the handoff week be 8/17–8/21.
- For benchmarking with Bridgepoint, please ensure we get the exact node list and test harness details by COB Monday so we can pre-populate dashboards. Jordan — can you upload the harness to the Drive link?

Also attaching a quick dependency matrix (dependency_matrix.csv) to map owners. Sofia, can you include that file in the playbook?

-Jonas

Thanks all — I support the two-week compressed playbook. A few operational points before we lock:

- Approvals: I'll take gatekeeper for the SLA-notification messaging and the QBR slide updates. I approve the infra reallocation conditional on acceptance criteria + rollback plan in the playbook.
- Procurement: please confirm the amendment status; procurement@acme-analytics.com, we need the signed MSA addendum to run dedicated tests by 8/11 or we will scope tests to hosted infra only.
- Customer comms: Sofia, let's keep the customer-facing note short and factual. I'll draft a one-paragraph template and share by Sunday night.

If Jordan confirms 8/11–8/13 access by COB Monday and Vivek confirms the SRE swap, we can proceed with the hotfix and the reduced-scope feature plan.

Laura
